subtitle: Local drive health and check history
scanNote: Long tests and full reads add disk load. Run them during quiet hours.
scoreNote: A current score requires a complete, unexpired assessment from one batch.
confirmStop: Stop the task? Surface progress is saved. Drive-internal SMART tests continue.
confirmStart: Start this check? Long tests and surface scans can take hours.
previewOnly: Static preview only. Disk data and controls require the local Web service.
unexpectedResponse: The server returned a web page instead of JSON. Open the local Web service address.
loginDescription: Enter the Web password to manage this device.
ipAccessDescription: Allow exact private IPv4 or unique-local IPv6 addresses to open the dashboard without a password.
ipAccessWarning: Anyone sharing an allowed address can use disk controls. Use this only on a trusted LAN.
passwordRequired: Sign in with the password to edit this list.
assessmentDescription: Run the selected check again for drives in this group.  Only a full assessment can establish a current composite score.
assessmentConfirm: Start this check for these drives?
assessmentWarning: Includes SMART short and long tests, speed sampling, and a full read-only surface scan. This can take hours and add load. SSD/NVMe scores use HDD-oriented rules and are not separately calibrated.
assessmentNoteQuick: Reads SMART and recent errors; brief drive access may wake a sleeping disk.
assessmentNoteShort: Starts the drive’s short SMART self-test; this may take several minutes.
assessmentNoteLong: Starts the drive’s long SMART self-test; this may take hours.
assessmentNoteSpeed: Samples read speed and can add disk load.
assessmentNoteSurface: Reads the entire drive for slow or unreadable areas; this may take hours.
assessmentNoteBadblocks: Runs a full read-only badblocks scan; this may take hours.
assessmentNoteIface: Runs the interface recheck and read stress test; this can add load.
assessmentNoteFull: Includes SMART short and long tests, speed sampling, and a full read-only surface scan. This may take hours. SSD/NVMe scores use HDD-oriented rules and are not separately calibrated.
assessmentNoteFullSsd: SSD full assessment runs SMART quick, short and long tests plus a full read-only scan. Speed sampling is skipped; slow reads alone do not reduce the score.
assessmentNoteFullMixed: Mixed full assessment skips speed sampling on SSDs. All drives receive SMART checks and a full read-only scan; only HDDs receive speed sampling.
unrecordedDeduction: Older result did not record the reason; points deducted:
unrecordedWarning: Older result is marked for attention without a recorded reason. Run the check again.
taskUnconfirmedDetail: The background process did not report a running or completed state. Check the log below and the NAS systemd journal.
taskNoLog: No log is available. Check the NAS systemd journal.
taskSummaryRunning: Running {module} on {count} disks. Results will update when the task finishes.
taskSummarySuccess: {module} finished on {count} disks without task errors. Open a disk for check results.
taskSummaryWarning: {module} finished on {count} disks with items needing attention. Open a disk for check results.
taskSummaryUnconfirmed: Could not confirm whether {module} finished on {count} disks. View the detailed log.
taskSummaryFailed: {module} did not finish on {count} disks. View the detailed log.
changePasswordDescription: Enter and confirm the new password while Security Settings are unlocked. A new login is required afterward.
passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match
passwordChangedLogin: Password changed. Sign in with the new password.
diskPowerPolicyDescription: Choose what happens when you open this Web page. This does not change scheduled or manual checks.
keepSleepingDescription: Read SMART without waking sleeping hard drives. Their temperature shows as Sleeping.
wakeOnVisitDescription: When this page opens, wake sleeping hard drives one at a time to read their temperature. This can take time and spin up the drives.
sleepingSmartNote: This drive is sleeping. SMART details will be available after it wakes.
storageNote: Capacity sums listed physical disks; used includes mounted filesystems and recognized ZFS pool allocation. RAID and unmounted volumes can change the comparison.
writesUnavailable: This drive does not report a reliable total.
noTaskHistory: No completed tasks have been recorded yet.
sleepDiskConfirm: System activity may wake the disk immediately. Put this disk in standby?
deleteJobConfirm: Delete this task record and detailed log?
deleteSampleConfirm: Delete this SMART trend sample? Future trend comparisons may change.
securitySettingsDescription: Verify the administrator password to manage credentials and IP access.
pageMotionHelp: Beta. Animates page changes only. Mobile browsers may show slight misalignment, so this starts off on iOS and Android. Theme and resize motion are separate.
ipLoginUnavailable: IP access is unavailable for this address. Sign in with the Web password, then manage private IP access in Settings → Security.
candidateIntro: This test build aligns every Web page with AI-Configs Web UI reference v1.2.3.
candidateNavigation: The same application header now keeps Home, Changelog, Settings and Sign out in order, with page-level Back controls and responsive Settings navigation.
candidateMotion: Page transitions and resize motion follow the shared visual reference. Page transitions can be switched off in Appearance settings.
candidateAccess: The login page always offers IP access; the server checks the actual address before granting access. Each page has its own matching browser-tab icon.
candidateLogin: Earlier post-release login updates align the header and card layout, place version and language controls in the login footer, and add independent password show/hide controls. Visitors can read Changelog before signing in.
languageDescription: Choose the language used by the interface.
appearanceDescription: Choose a light or dark mode and an accent color.
readsUnavailable: This drive does not report a reliable read total.
smartTableHelp: SMART raw values and units vary by vendor. Normalized values are vendor scores; lower values may be worse. A threshold is the vendor failure limit, not a health score. Hover or focus an attribute for its meaning.
smartReallocatedHelp: The drive moved data from unusable sectors. A rising count needs attention.
smartPendingHelp: Sectors waiting for a successful reread or remapping.
smartUncorrectableHelp: Sectors that could not be corrected during an offline test.
smartInterfaceHelp: Interface transmission errors; check the cable or connection if the count rises.
smartWearHelp: Estimated flash wear; the vendor defines the scale.
smartPowerHelp: Power-on time or cycle count; usage context, not a failure verdict.
smartErrorsHelp: Reported device or media errors; check whether the count is increasing.
smartTemperatureHelp: Device temperature; compare with its own warning limits.
smartReadHelp: Host data read or read commands. Counter units vary; use the total above when available.
smartWrittenHelp: Host data written or write commands. Counter units vary; use the total above when available.
smartSpareHelp: Remaining spare flash blocks and their warning threshold.
smartWarningHelp: Device warning flags; inspect other fields and run diagnostics.
smartShutdownHelp: Power loss without a clean shutdown.
smartGenericHelp: Vendor-defined attribute; compare trends and consult device documentation.
candidateDiskDetail: Disk details now open as full pages; serials can be revealed and copied on request.
candidateSmart: SMART attributes show explanations on hover or focus, and supported SSDs show host reads and writes.
smartBusyHelp: Time the controller spent busy handling I/O; the reported unit is device-specific.
smartTemperatureDurationHelp: Time spent above the warning or critical temperature limit; sustained exposure needs attention.
